verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say the Kimi assistant itself lets users upload their own files and answer questions based on them, which gives AI-generated insight from user data inside the product. Kimi Code's agent also reads a user's local codebase for whole-project understanding. Only user-prompted Q&A over uploaded files is documented, and there is no evidence of proactive insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insight and suggestion generation, documented analytics or summarization of user data beyond file Q&A, and independent or hands-on corroboration of assistant-side data insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files.
A million-token context loads an entire large codebase with cross-module dependencies in one pass, enabling whole-project understanding and refactoring.
